module: Procedural sidewalks/curbs of a Hero Road Editor group. Thin layer on top of the shared sweep toolUtilities/walkRibbon: reads the actual banked edges of the mesh (meshEdgeL/R, meshEdgeDirL/R) and sweeps curb + paving along each enabled side (group.sidewalkLeft / sidewalkRight). During editing it is a transient ProceduralMesh 'HeroWalk_<id>'; the bake writes it to .dae and places a persistent TSStatic in its place.
notes: Both sides are merged into ONE mesh (two draws in total).
The sidewalk's Z height is that of the roadway edge (p.z), not p.z + d.z*offset, so that it stays level despite the superelevation.
The offset from the edge is group.sidewalkOffsetM (>= 0, default 0); the width comes from walkRibbon.width(). Crosswalks (group.crossings) lower the curb flush via walkRibbon.crossingDips.
The mesh is collidable (meshPart.emitObject with collision) but not saved (canSave=false) while the road is being edited.
The baked sidewalk has only one level of detail (NEAR_PX = 400); collisionType 'Collision Mesh', decalType 'Visible Mesh Final'.
The runtime records (mesh, parts) are kept in the module, indexed by group.id, and never on the group.

updateGroup.desc: (Re)builds the group's sidewalks from the current mesh edge and the sidewalkLeft/sidewalkRight toggles. Called right after the mesh rebuild. Does nothing without a scene folder (sceneTreeFolderId); creates nothing if no triangle is produced.

removeGroup.desc: Deletes the group's sidewalk mesh and forgets it.

tris.desc: Number of triangles of the group's sidewalk, for the tool's count.

returns.desc: Number of triangles, 0 if no sidewalk.

burnGroup.desc: Bake: writes the sidewalk to <dir>/HeroWalk_<id>.dae (centered on its own center) and places a persistent TSStatic (canSave=true) in its place, after deleting the procedural mesh that has the same name. On write failure, logs an error ('heroSidewalk') and the sidewalk disappears from this bake.

dir.desc: Bake folder (created if it does not exist), with trailing slash.

returns.desc: Manifest of the created scene object names (empty if nothing to bake); used to remove the static at unbake.
